resources.string: Earth screensaver inspired by Mondiversi, available offline with day/night lighting.
Screensaver enabled by default after 5 minutes; activation and delay are saved.
Gradual dawn and dusk lighting across sky, ground, weather and panoramic captures.
Main controls grouped at the corners; status messages centered below the reticle.
Clearer camera zoom beside the shutter, with direct preset selection.
More room for object names, a 55/45 landscape layout and initial music volume at 50%.
